hypothesis: The scan instructions define trust boundaries through application-user examples without explaining a library's public API contract. This can encourage invented downstream services or credential uses for ordinary library behavior. A shared contract-based boundary instruction in the finder and verifier may reduce those false reports while preserving intrinsic security/identity-integrity defects.
developmentEvidence: The already inspected baseline development sample and the three retained control snapshots. No findings from the active remote positive/confirmation run have been read for this hypothesis.
changeScope: Only generic security-scan prompt framing, shared between the lens and its verification focus. No repository names, case IDs, advisory locations or expected verdicts in production prompts. No blanket exclusion for libraries or APIs named unsafe.
invariants: Keep the same DeepSeek model route, reasoning settings, seven classes, tools, unit limit and per-case USD caps.
Do not change advisory matching, precision targets, unknown-findings policy or sample selection.
Accept real violations under supported use, including broken advertised validation, memory safety or shared identity integrity.
Do not invent a downstream HTTP endpoint, protected plugin runtime or credential consumer.
A deliberately omitted guarantee does not excuse a different violated security guarantee.
measurement: Compare the pinned before/after code on the same development and confirmation cases and the original controls. Keep all historical results, including the real UUID defect and false reports. The supplemental xxhash control remains unseen by the model until its preregistered run.
confirmation: Do not use confirmation descriptions to develop this correction. Freeze their selected samples, finalize the candidate, then adjudicate and compare the confirmation outputs.
acceptance: Require measured precision at least 60% per language, retain recall and coverage/spend trade-offs, and complete valid negative-control evidence. A prompt edit or scripted-model pass alone is no quality improvement claim.
